headline: Armed group boards and seizes cargo ship off the coast of Yemen
label: BREAKING
caption:
An armed group has boarded and taken control of a cargo ship off the coast of Yemen according to reports.

The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported that armed individuals boarded the vessel near Balhaf.

Authorities have not yet provided further details about the identity of the ship or the armed group involved in the incident.

Investigations and monitoring operations are currently underway in the area following the seizure.
